## Highlights

- **List page:** 300ms debounced search (`q`), status filter, clickable rows
- **Detail page:** PUT for edits, status buttons from `ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS`, invalid transitions show API message in `ErrorBanner`
- **API client:** Parses `fieldErrors` into readable messages (e.g. `title: must not be blank`)

## Run

```bash
cd support-ticket-ui
npm install
npm run dev
```

Requires the backend on port 8080. `npm` was not available in this environment, so the build was not verified here.
